div.p: A merge occurs on the node with key 20 in the following 2-3-4 tree. Which is the resulting tree?

img.alt: A 2-3-4 tree. Root contains key 45. The root's left child contains key 20 and right child contains keys 55 and 65. Node 20's left child contains key 15 and right child contains key 30. Node 55 and 65's left child contains key 50, middle child contains key 60, and right child contains key 70.

A 2-3-4 tree. Root contains key 55. The root's left child contains key 45 and right child contains key 65. Node 45's left child contains keys 15, 20, and 30 and right child contains key 50. Node 65's left child contains key 60 and right child contains key 70.
A 2-3-4 tree. Root contains keys 30 and 55. The root's left child contains keys 15 and 20. The root's middle child contains keys 45 and 50. The root's right child contains keys 60, 65, and 70.

A 2-3-4 tree. Root contains key 45. The root's left child contains keys 15, 20, and 30. The root's right child contains keys 55 and 65. Node 55 and 65's left child contains 50, middle child contains 60, and right child contains 70.

A 2-3-4 tree. Root contains key 55. The root's left child contains keys 20 and 45 and the right child contains key 65. Node 20 and 45's left child contains key 15, middle child contains key 30, and right child contains key 50. Node 65's left child contains 60 and right child contains 70.
